owner_request: Review and tidy BandMaster UI/UX across the game: fixed navigation position, less text and fewer simultaneous options, particularly auditions and songwriting. Put each interacting character front and centre, one speech/question with about three player replies, then reveal the next exchange in the same scene; use similar pacing for rehearsal.
scope: Presentation-only first cleanup: shared top navigation in career/practice/audition/writing; grouped destination choices; character-first audition, musician and promoter conversations; staged existing songwriting/rehearsal decisions. Existing models, authored content, art/audio, save schema and settlement remain protected.

target.purpose: Actual retained phone/short originals reopened; source-confirmed excessive simultaneous options and moving navigation. Latest owner conversational direction defines the new presentation target, without claiming an approved new mockup.

hypothesis: A fixed top return/title/Menu row plus character-first turns and free local disclosure of one decision at a time will remove competing choices while retaining all existing options and exact original commitment owners.
controlled_comparison: Same pinned source, canonical cast, QA fixtures, viewport, state, background and source art. Capture actual baseline/current first folds and the same complete tasks at 390x844,720x1280,1280x720,1600x900. Explicitly record layout changes; no claim of pixel identity for redesigned regions.
stop_condition: Hold any essential hidden/clipped context/action, unsafe dirty exit, unintentional saved choice on rapid repeat, changed gameplay/content fingerprint, duplicated settlement or save loss. Log defects before iteration and change method after two ineffective attempts. No APK/rebuild/signing/new art/new dialogue content.
validation_commands: Pinned Godot4.7.2 isolated clean import and script-error check with protected signing tools and custom user directory
tools/ux70_verify.py: matched native baseline/candidate, early phone and short followed by tall/wide
Actual pointer/key/scroll, first-fold character/dialogue/replies, fixed navigation, hidden-focus and physical target checks
Whole owner/file equality on free phase/disclosure; dirty Save/Discard/Keep and actual filesystem failure/retry; original one-day and selected-song £15 settlement/reload guards
Unchanged model/art/audio/save dependency hashes and explicitly source-bound reuse of prior model proofs
next_action: Implement and verify UX70 character-first conversations, progressive choices and fixed navigation against the pinned baseline.

predesign.findings: Career destinations switch top/bottom; audition presents talk/music/decision simultaneously; main writing buries 48px partner after controls; rehearsal shows song/focus/pace/reference together. Authored audition questions have two choices, so retain two plus truthful noncommitting path; no fabricated third reply.
visible_acceptance: Return and Menu at consistent top coordinates, outside scroll; explicit END AUDITION preserves abort semantics
Existing character portrait and one source-backed speech precede at most three current conversation replies
A reply reveals the next local stage without navigating away or committing another action
Rehearsal song/focus/pace/review remain local until original explicit costed start
Optional conversation stays optional; no repeated click reaches a second answer or a paid commitment
No reduced type, altered protected art/controls, hidden financial/time commitments, false saved/current meaning

player_task.goal: Understand the current person or musical decision and take the next intended action without getting lost.
player_task.start: Saved band home or canonical audition candidate; same current source fixtures.
player_task.end: Saved original audition result, writing stage or selected-song rehearsal recap, then safe return/resume.
player_task.commitments: Owner audition_action talk/abort/invite; explicit workbench commit; selected-song rehearsal owner. Presentation changes never own gameplay settlement.

risk_matrix: long Unicode titles and explicit selected partner
dirty local edits and true filesystem failure
one-save original settlement and exact typed reload
